fullContentHtml:
UPSC Civil Services IAS Mains Result 2026 – Full Details

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the mains exam date for the post of Civil Services / Forest Service IAS / IFS. This recruitment was released for 1013 posts. Applications for the UPSC IFS Mains Online Form 2026 were accepted from 13 July 2026, to 22 July 2026. The Mains Examination is going to conducted from 22-29 November 2026. Candidates must Download their UPSC IFS Mains Exam Date 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 04 February 2026
  • Last Date : 27 February 2026 (Extended)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 27 February 2027
  • Correction/ Edit Form : 28 February to 03 March 2026
  • Pre Exam Date : 24 May 2026
  • Admit Card : 15 May 2026
  • Answer Key : 27 May 2026
  • Result : 15 June 2026
  • Name Wise Result : 17 June 2026
  • Mains Online Form IAS
  • Application Start Date : 19 June 2026
  • Last Date : 29 June 2026
  • Mains Online Form IFS
  • Application Start Date : 13 July 2026
  • Last Date : 22 July 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 21, 22, 23, 29, 30 August 2026
  • IAS Mains Admit Card : 14 August 2026
  • IFS Mains Exam Date : 22-29 November 2026
  • Check the Important Links section.
  • After clicking on the link, candidates will be redirected to the Dashboard page.

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, SC, Female, PH : 0/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UPSC Civil Services IAS Mains Result 2026?

UPSC Civil Services IAS Mains Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
